requirements.verifier_assertion: Grader loads index.html and scores tCov against it; any other filename scores zero
T1: after 3s wait, modelLoaded===true, arrowsRemaining===5, score===0, bestShot===0, arrowInFlight===false, roundNumber===1, windX is a finite number
must_include: bestShot (best single arrow score, starts at 0)

requirements.verifier_assertion: Rubric affordance A1: Xbot.glb archer via GLTFLoader at (0,0,6), bare filename, graceful degrade
T2: after 'd' key, debugVisible===true, #debugOverlay exists and is shown; initially hidden
must_include: Initially the debug overlay is hidden (display:none)

requirements.verifier_assertion: T3: after Space, arrowInFlight===true, currentArrowPos/currentArrowVel non-null, velocity.z<0, arrowsRemaining===4
must_include: Press SPACE to shoot an arrow

requirements.verifier_assertion: T4: after flight, arrowInFlight===false, arrowsRemaining===4, totalArrowsFired===1, lastHitDistance non-null, lastHitScore 0..10
must_include: When an arrow's Z position reaches <= -14.8
measuring XY distance from target center (0, 2.5)
lastHitScore (number, points from last arrow, 0 if miss)

requirements.verifier_assertion: Rubric affordance A2: 5 concentric ring target at (0,2.5,-15), scores 1/3/5/7/10 by ring
must_include: circular archery target at position (0, 2.5, -15) facing positive Z

requirements.verifier_assertion: T5: after another Space, score is a finite number, bestShot in 0..10, arrows decremented
must_include: bestShot (best single arrow score, starts at 0)

requirements.verifier_assertion: T6/T7: after 5 shots, arrowsRemaining===0, totalArrowsFired>=5, no negative score; further Space does nothing
T8: after #resetBtn click, arrowsRemaining===5, score===0, bestShot===0, roundNumber>=2, windX finite
must_include: roundNumber (number, starts at 1, increments on reset)
Wind changes randomly each time a new round starts (on reset)

requirements.verifier_assertion: T9: after reset then Space, roundNumber>=2, arrowsRemaining<=4, totalArrowsFired>=1, score is a number
must_include: Press SPACE to shoot an arrow
roundNumber (number, starts at 1, increments on reset)

requirements.verifier_assertion: T10: after 'd' key again, debugVisible===false, #debugOverlay hidden
Rubric affordances A5/A6/A7/A9: score/arrows/bestShot/wind HUD DOM ids present
Rubric affordance A10: red crosshair reticle following the mouse
Rubric affordance A3: arrow is a thin brown cylinder with a cone tip
Wind vector applies constant horizontal X force to arrows; windX exposed in state
must_include: constant wind force on the X axis

requirements.verifier_assertion: All physics values NaN-free; animation via requestAnimationFrame + THREE.Clock delta
must_include: requestAnimationFrame with delta time from THREE.Clock
